one_liner: Karl-Anthony Towns shoots 40.2 percent from three while pulling 12.2 rebounds per 36 minutes -- a combination almost nobody in this atlas repeats.
three_things: 40.2 percent from three at 12.2 rebounds per 36.
The scoring volume is real too: 24.2 points per 36 on 51.1 percent shooting.
Free-throw accuracy of 85.1 percent confirms the shooting touch is not a fluke of small samples.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
